text: jess: Quick sync noticed a handful of internal guides have fragment drift after the recent copy-edit sweep. Links from the quickstart and runtime examples are landing above the intended headings. Anyone able to take the tiny fixes (anchor aliases + smoke checks)? omar: Can you list the pages so I can pick one? jess: Short list I found via linkcheck: /guides/prefix-caching (EN) -> fragment #cache-behavior but pt has #cacheBehavior; /guides/fallback-routing (EN) -> #fallback-order vs ja #fallback_order; and /runtime/examples -> link to /guides/prefix-caching#cache-behavior is 404 in staging for pt. l10n-bot: linkcheck: fragment mismatch detected for /pt/guides/prefix-caching (referrer: /guides/prefix-caching). First seen 2026-03-04. rachel: localization usually owns the translated pages but small alias anchors are ok from docs. would rather we avoid renaming EN anchors. @omar if you want to own PT patches, that would be great. omar: I can take pt fixes. Plan: add alias anchors in pt files and a one-line curl smoke test in docs-smoke/quickchecks that asserts the fragment resolves. Will also add a KB entry so translators know to keep anchor casing consistent. jess: Awesome. Example sed/awk I used to test locally (run from repo root): ```bash # insert alias anchor before heading in pt file awk '/^#+ Cache behavior/{print ""}1' pt/guides/prefix-caching.md > tmp && mv tmp pt/guides/prefix-caching.md # smoke check: expect 200 and fragment preserved curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/pt/guides/prefix-caching#cache-behavior" ``` rachel: LGTM. docs-ci: when adding smoke checks please gate them so they only run for changed pages. We don't want the full suite on tiny anchors. docs-ci: noted. We'll accept a single-curl microtest under smoke/quickchecks and run it conditionally when files under pt/guides/ are modified. Also recommend adding a quick grep linter to CI to flag camelCase anchors in localized content so we can catch these during backports. omar: I'll open a PR with: 1) alias anchors in pt/guides/prefix-caching.md and ja/guides/fallback-routing.md, 2) add a tiny smoke test script smoke/quickchecks/anchor-resolve.sh that takes a list of url fragments (kept tiny), 3) a KB note at /kb/anchor-backport-guidance.md with examples and the recommended pattern (lowercase-dash). jess: Tiny ask: in the PR description include the original auto-detected linkcheck IDs from l10n-bot so translators can reconcile. olivier: (bot) note: linkcheck run summary attached to PR when you add the l10n-bot tag. omar: PR opened: #5201-anchor-aliases-and-smoke. Assigning rachel and jess for review, cc docs-ci and l10n-bot. rachel: I'll review today. One more thing 4dd please add a single-line KB note that suggests "prefer lower-case-dash anchors; translators should not rename headings without propagating the anchor". Saves future drift. jess: Great. After merge I'll shepherd a tiny follow-up to add a lint rule to flag camelCase anchors in localized content. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
